title: 74쪽 · 3x CO Open — BB Defense
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Optimal cutoff opens are significantly tighter than optimal button opens. A few major alterations need to be made to your big blind defense range.
Eliminate the A-2 - A-50 S-bets (you wan't be able to generate enough fold equity against a tighter range)
Eliminate the suited gappers (I know they look pretty, but they
won't hold-up against three barrels from a solid opponent) Eliminate the weaker suited K-x hands (kicker issues are Magnified against tighter ranges).
All of this is, of course, assuming that the cutoff is opening at an optimal frequency. If he’s opening a button range, go back to a wider defense range 3-bet more liberally, and create some chaos!
